name: Mitchell
gaps: Parcels are WebMapNew Parcels (CAMA + polygons) (https://mapping.mitchellcountync.gov/arcgis/rest/services/WebMapNew/MapServer/12). Acreage is 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
Source query returned 4221 rows; 3835 stayed in the 5.0–150.0 acre band after the parcel-id and geometry checks.
Pass 2 enrichment is from card pass2 (tax ok, sale partial). Pass 2 counted 123 NCDOT 2022 AADT stations. NCDOT AADT stays the query-time statewide join.
Pass 2 sale: Price not on REST; NCPTS Mitchell parcel-detail page is the public source.
Property-appraiser links are stored from the card or pass-2 pattern and were not requested. Owner phone and email are not ingested.
